news_feeds.title: US NFP August — Strong Beat +162k
news_feeds.body:
Nonfarm payrolls +162,000 (vs ~55k consensus). Unemployment rate steady at 4.1%. Average hourly earnings +0.3% MoM / +3.1% YoY.

Prior months revised higher (June +11k to +31k, July from −23k to +21k). Leisure & hospitality and local government education led gains.

Market take: clear labor-market resilience. Supports USD and lifts September Fed hike odds. Treasury yields rose on the print.

news_feeds.title: Canada Employment soft −42k
news_feeds.body:
Canada lost 41,700–42,000 jobs in August after strong summer hiring. Unemployment rate held at 6.4%. Full-time jobs led the decline. Wage growth cooled to 2% YoY.

CAD under pressure on the soft print amid ongoing trade uncertainty.

news_feeds.title: ISM Services PMI 55.4 — Demand strong, prices sticky
news_feeds.body:
ISM Services rose to 55.4 from 54.1 (beat). Business Activity 61.7, New Orders 60.9. Employment still contracting at 47.8. Prices Paid jumped to 72.6 (highest in years).

Mixed for Fed: growth resilient but inflation pressure remains elevated.

news_feeds.title: Market Compass — Post-NFP
news_feeds.body:
NFP beat lifts USD and yields. Canada jobs soft weighs on CAD. Gold rebounded hard. BTC pushed through 80k.

Next focus: US CPI (11 Sep) and FOMC (16-17 Sep).
